altered_requirement:
# Requirement #2234: The analyzer should not report diagnostics if SuppressSourceGeneration = true

Source: https://github.com/MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp/issues/2234

#### Bug description

The analyzer still reports diagnostics for types with SuppressSourceGeneration = true. It should skip all MessagePack analyzer checks for such types, because no formatter is generated and they are serialized at run time. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

requirement_points.text: When SuppressSourceGeneration is true, the analyzer is still active and runs as part of the compilation.
When SuppressSourceGeneration is true, the analyzer reports its diagnostics for user code that violates its rules.
The analyzer does not require any source-generated types or files to be present in the compilation in order to produce its diagnostics.
The analyzer does not throw an exception or fail to load when SuppressSourceGeneration is true.

plants.description: Changed continue to break, so after the first member whose key kind does not match the rest, the analyzer abandons the remaining members of the type and never reports their diagnostics.
Inverted the duplicate-key guard so the member is added only when the key is already present, causing Dictionary.Add to throw ArgumentException and the analyzer to fail.
Field members are registered under hiddenIntKey rather than member.IntKey, corrupting the int-key map and hiding duplicate-key diagnostics.
The uniqueness check and dictionary key use member.Name instead of member.StringKey, so duplicate string keys are never detected and members are tracked under the wrong key.
Removed the early continue for field members whose key kind does not match; the code now falls through and dereferences a null key, throwing NullReferenceException.
Equivalent boolean rewrite of the guard; no behaviour change.
Indexer assignment is equivalent to Add here because the guard already checked absence.
Equivalent pattern-based boolean rewrite of the guard; no behaviour change.
Removed the registration of int-keyed property members, so later members can never detect a duplicate int key and the KeysMustBeUnique diagnostic is no longer reported.
Removed the registration of string-keyed property members, so duplicate string keys go undetected and the analyzer stops reporting them.
